allocationScope: UI-thread C++ calls; live delta excludes aligned blocks and COM/driver heaps
timingScope: layoutAndPrepareMs/threadCycles include phase mutation setters and all layout/preparation; prepareMs excludes manual layout but includes Form intrinsic layout and is variant-dependent; compositeMs/threadCycles measure submission; completedFrameMs also includes target bind/clear and blocking one-pixel GPU completion
deviceRecoveryScope: public ReplaceDevice generation recovery; no hardware removed-device qualification
nativeIdentityScope: source, fixture, executable and complete build identity must accompany this raw report in the PowerShell packet
benchmarkInputsScope: benchmarkInputs and benchmarkSha256 retain the shared helper historical ComplexUi closure; formBenchmarkInputs binds this Form layout fixture, dispatcher and runner.
measurement: Candidate-only Manual/Form layout diagnostic. No baseline/candidate regression or policy qualification verdict. Allocation calls/bytes include aligned new; plain live-byte deltas exclude aligned blocks. All UI-thread C++ counters exclude COM/driver heaps.
